question: Should OpenClaw accept read-scoped runtime-config drift path names and per-cache-hit disk snapshot reads as the health diagnostic tradeoff for this PR?
rationale: The patch is additive and well-tested, but the auth-adjacent visibility boundary and health RPC freshness cost are product and operations choices that CI cannot fully settle.

options.title: Accept Diagnostic Boundary
options.body: Land after exact-head CI because the diff is additive, redaction is tested, and supplied terminal proof shows the normal read-scoped health path behavior.

options.title: Request Extra Privacy Or Latency Proof
options.body: Ask for a read-vs-admin transcript or a health latency sample if maintainers are not comfortable with drift path visibility or per-request disk reads.

options.title: Pause For Companion Policy PR
options.body: Hold this PR only if maintainers want diagnostics and the hot-mode restart-policy PR at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89517 reviewed as one bundle.

recommendation.title: Accept Diagnostic Boundary
recommendation.body: Land after exact-head CI because the diff is additive, redaction is tested, and supplied terminal proof shows the normal read-scoped health path behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: His current-main history is the strongest signal for the health cache and health payload code path this PR changes.
